headlines.title: Model N Appoints Koti Reddy Nandyala as Chief Technology Officer to Accelerate Platform Innovation
headlines.summary: Former Salesforce and Conga executive brings more than 25 years of experience transforming enterprise software and leading global engineering teams Koti Reddy Nandyala, Chief Technology Officer, Model N Model N has appointed Koti Reddy Nandyala as Chief Technology Officer. Nandyala brings more than 25 years of experience transforming enterprise software platforms and building global engineering teams, including roles at Salesforce, Conga and Callidus Cloud. REDWOOD CITY, Calif., Nov.

headlines.title: Salesforce Spent $32 Billion on Buybacks in 5 Years. Somehow, Its Share Count Still Rose
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysSalesforce spent about $32 billion on buybacks in the five fiscal years to January 2026, yet its diluted share count rose from 930 million to 956 million. Most of that money offset stock pay and the shares Salesforce issued to buy Slack, so shareholders’ slice of the company didn’t grow.

headlines.title: Trifecta Technologies Expands Product Data Capabilities with Salsify and Salesforce B2B Commerce Integration
headlines.summary: Trifecta Technologies, a technology consulting and systems integration firm, today announced expanded capabilities leveraging Salsify's Product Experience Management (PXM) platform and Salesforce B2B Commerce to help organizations better manage, govern and activate product data across their digital ecosystems.

headlines.title: Main Capital Partners Invests in TaskRay, Joining Cloud Coach and JustOn to Transform Customer Delivery on Salesforce
headlines.summary: Main Capital Partners ("Main") has invested in TaskRay, an AI-native project management platform built on Salesforce, joining it with portfolio company Cloud Coach and its German subsidiary JustOn. Together, the three companies aim to redefine customer delivery with an AI-powered platform connecting project management, resource management, professional services automation (PSA), and financial operations for enterprises.

headlines.title: Salesforce vs. Oracle: Which AI Cloud Stock Is the Smarter Pick Now?
headlines.summary: CRM vs. ORCL: Both stocks trade at similar valuations, but stronger AI monetization, earnings growth and lower capital intensity give CRM the edge.

description: Salesforce, Inc. provides customer relationship management technology services that connect companies and customers together in the United States, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. The company offers Agentforce, which enables customers to build, deploy, and manage enterprise-grade, autonomous AI agents at scale, enabling humans and agents to work together; Agentforce Sales, an integrated platform that brings together the power of humans with AI agents to help sales teams for selling, managing, and automating entire sales processes; Agentforce Service, which enables companies in every industry to bring all of their customer, employee, IT, and field service needs onto one integrated AI-powered platform; Data 360, a data engine that gives AI agents their context and serves as the foundation for how customers unify service offerings, making their data actionable for both humans and agents; Informatica, an AI-powered data management platform that enables customers to discover, integrate, govern, and deliver trusted data at scale across hybrid and multi-cloud environments; and Slack, a conversational interface for the agentic enterprise where people and agents work together, connecting knowledge, actions, and data in real time. It also provides marketing platforms; commerce services, which empower shopping experiences across various customer touchpoints; integration and analytics solutions; Salesforce Starter, a suite for small and medium-sized businesses that brings sales, service, marketing, and commerce together; and a field service solution that enables companies to connect service agents, dispatchers, and mobile employees through one centralized platform to schedule and dispatch work, as well as track and manage jobs. It serves financial services, healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, automotive, and government sectors. Salesforce, Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
